title: Status line: add an unstaged counter to the git group
story: The status line now tells changes still waiting for git add apart from changes already staged: an unstaged:N word right after modified:N, which still counts both kinds. A file staged and then edited again counts in both.

checks.criterion: A repository with one staged and one unstaged change shows unstaged:1, and the modified count is the same as before.
checks.steps: In a new folder run git init and commit one.txt and two.txt. Add a line to one.txt and git add it; add a line to two.txt without adding it. Open Claude Code there with orion's status line installed.
checks.expected: The git group reads stashed:0 untracked:0 modified:2 unstaged:1 unpushed:0, with unstaged in cyan.
